# NEW 2026-11-22 v17.0 Across Eras & Symphonies — Module 17.0-C1: Scripted Effects & O(1) Zero-Slot Yearly Hook (oe_aa2_kernel_yearly) (oe_aa2_, 0 mainline slots, 0 rules, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v170_africa_americas.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Zero-slot yearly dispatcher exported for oe_gk_yearly_dispatch (global or country scope).
# Self-deduplicates per calendar year via global_var:oe_aa2_ran_y so it never double-fires.
oe_aa2_kernel_yearly = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { global_var:oe_aa2_ran_y ?= current_year }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_aa2_ran_y value = current_year }
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				oe_aa2_is_target_realm = yes
			}
			oe_aa2_country_yearly_dispatch = yes
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Routes each Africa & Americas realm to its regional chronological event chain.
oe_aa2_country_yearly_dispatch = {
	if = { limit = { oe_aa2_is_mal_host = yes } oe_aa2_dispatch_mal = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { oe_aa2_is_kil_host = yes } oe_aa2_dispatch_kil = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { oe_aa2_is_kon_host = yes } oe_aa2_dispatch_kon = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { oe_aa2_is_iro_host = yes } oe_aa2_dispatch_iro = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { oe_aa2_is_may_host = yes } oe_aa2_dispatch_may = yes }
}

oe_aa2_dispatch_mal = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			current_year >= 1345
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_aa2_ev_1_done }
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_aa2_ev_1_done value = 1 }
